intro: Changchun rewards visitors with compact squares, hearty northeastern food, and easy rail links across the region. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro and light rail: 6 lines (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8) cover many central areas; T-Union card works.
Trams 54 and 55 run in the west; fare ¥2, route 55 ends at West station.
Buses are extensive and cost about ¥2; Chinese reading helps a lot.
Taxis are cheap and easy; flag fall ¥5 plus ¥1 fuel surcharge.
Ride apps: Didi works; local apps may need Chinese registration.
Walking is fine May to mid-November; cycling is risky in traffic.

manchukuo_palace.name: Museum of the Imperial Palace of Manchukuo
manchukuo_palace.landmark: Museum of the Imperial Palace of Manchukuo
manchukuo_palace.price_text: ≈ CNY 70 adult · discounts for students and seniors (check on the day)
manchukuo_palace.hours: Tue–Sun roughly 08:30–17:00 · closed Monday (check on the day)
manchukuo_palace.tip: This is the former puppet-state palace of Puyi. Allow two hours and take the audio guide if available.

jingyuetan.name: Jingyuetan National Forest Park
jingyuetan.tip: A big lake and forest southeast of the city. Rent a bike or take the small boat; bring water and snacks.

changchun_film_museum.name: Changchun Film Studio Museum
changchun_film_museum.tip: Changchun is China's film city. Good for a rainy day and film buffs.

nanhu_park.name: Nanhu Park
nanhu_park.tip: A central lake park. Locals walk, fish and skate here in winter.

guilin_road.name: Guilin Road food street
guilin_road.price_text: Pay per stall · budget CNY 30–80 per person
guilin_road.hours: Busiest from late afternoon to night
guilin_road.tip: Korean-Chinese snacks, barbecue and cold noodles. Point at what looks good and pay by phone or cash.

chongqing_road.name: Chongqing Road shopping walk
chongqing_road.tip: The main commercial street. Good for a stroll, department stores and coffee.

peoples_square.name: People's Square
peoples_square.tip: A central square near the old colonial-era buildings. Good starting point for a walk.

wenhua_square.name: Culture Square and Geological Palace
wenhua_square.price_text: Free to walk; museum entry varies
wenhua_square.tip: The old geology building is a city landmark. Walk the square and nearby streets.

changchun_station_area.name: Old railway station area walk
changchun_station_area.tip: Look for the Japanese-era buildings around the station. Keep to main streets and go in daylight.

northeast_dish.name: Northeast Chinese dinner (dongbei cai)
northeast_dish.tip: Order fewer dishes than people — portions are huge. Try guo bao rou (sweet-sour pork).

korean_town.name: Korean-Chinese neighbourhood food walk
korean_town.tip: Changchun has a strong Korean-Chinese food culture. Try cold noodles (lengmian) and rice cakes.

winter_ice_festival.name: Winter ice and snow displays
winter_ice_festival.price_text: Varies by site · check on the day
winter_ice_festival.tip: Changchun winters are very cold. Dress in layers and go after dark for the lights.

city_tour.name: Half-day city history tour
city_tour.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–300 per person (check on the day)
city_tour.tip: A guide helps explain the Manchukuo-era history. Confirm language and pickup before booking.

south_lake_view.name: Nanhu lake viewpoint
south_lake_view.tip: Walk the lake path for open views. Best light is early morning or sunset.

market_snacks.name: Local morning market snacks
market_snacks.tip: Go early for fresh breakfast items. Bring small cash and a bag.

hongqi_walk.name: Hongqi Street evening walk
hongqi_walk.tip: A broad avenue with shops and food. Good for an easy evening stroll.

park_cycling.name: Jingyuetan bike loop
park_cycling.price_text: ≈ CNY 30–60 bike rental (check on the day)
park_cycling.tip: Rent a bike near the main gate and ride the lake road. Bring water and sun protection.

history_museum.name: Jilin Provincial Museum
history_museum.price_text: Free with ID (check on the day)
history_museum.tip: Good for regional history and art. Bring your passport for entry.

tea_house.name: Afternoon tea and rest stop
tea_house.tip: A warm place to sit in winter. Order tea and a snack and watch the street.

snow_play.name: Winter snow play area
snow_play.price_text: Varies by site · check on the day
snow_play.tip: Sledding and snow play for families. Rent warm gear if you are not prepared.

night_market.name: Evening street food stalls
night_market.tip: Try grilled skewers and local snacks. Pay by phone is common; keep some cash.

city_view.name: Rooftop city view
city_view.price_text: Free or cost of a drink (check on the day)
city_view.tip: Find a high cafe or mall terrace for a wide view over the city.

day_trip.name: Countryside day trip
day_trip.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–400 per person (check on the day)
day_trip.tip: Ask your hotel to arrange a driver for the day. Confirm the return time and price first.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Puppet-state palace, film museum and wartime sites.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Park lakes, forests and winter ice on the rivers.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Northeast barbecue, dumplings and street snacks.

stays.why: Central and walkable; metro lines 1 and 2 meet here, so most sights are a short ride away.
Shopping and food street; busy at night, easy taxis, good budget-to-mid choice.
Student and Korean-food district; cheapest eats and a lively evening scene.
Quieter, greener area near the car industry district; handy if you have business there.

food: Try Northeast barbecue (chuan'r) and guo bao rou, sweet-and-sour pork slices. Portions are big; share.
Dumplings and cold noodles are cheap and filling; a meal often costs ¥20–40.
Guilin Road has Korean and student food: stews, fried chicken, late-night snacks.
Winter markets sell frozen pears and tanghulu; eat them outside, they are meant to be cold.
Look for hot pot and iron-pot stews in winter. Book ahead on weekend evenings.
more_time: Add a half-day at Jingyuetan park: lake walks, forest trails and winter skiing; check opening hours on the day.
History fans can swap a shopping afternoon for the Film Museum and the old puppet-state buildings; check tickets on the day.
In winter, swap a park visit for an indoor museum or the hot springs outside town; check transport on the day.
